svg.title: Tech stack, by field
svg.desc: AI Agents & LLMs: Google ADK, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents, Amazon Bedrock, Claude, Gemini 2.5, OpenAI, Model Context Protocol, RAG, LangChain, Claude Code plugins, Agent evaluation. Machine Learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, OpenCV, Multimodal emotion recognition, Feature engineering, Embeddings, Semantic search, LLMs. Backend & APIs: Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, SQL, FastAPI, Go Fiber, Spring Boot, Express, Node.js, OpenAPI / Swagger, Pub/Sub, Async pipelines. Frontend & 10-foot UI: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix, Material UI, Vite, React Native, Vega OS / Fire TV, Accessibility: 7:1 contrast, 32 pt. Data & Vector Search: PostgreSQL, Aurora Serverless v2, Row-Level Security, pgvector (HNSW), Pinecone, Redis, MongoDB, Firestore, Cosmos DB, MySQL. Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Google Cloud, Cloud Run, Azure, AKS, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Nginx, Vercel, Render. Observability & Quality: Dynatrace, Davis AI, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Sentry, k6, Vitest, JUnit, SonarCloud.
